description: Commercial and Non Commercial Flights per Month, Port Authority of NY NJ: Beginning 1977 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The dataset presented in this forum is monthly data. The Port Authority collects monthly data for domestic and international cargo, flights, passengers and aircraft equipment type from each carrier at PANYNJ-operated airports. The data is aggregated and forms the basis for estimating flight fees, parking, concession, and PFC revenues at the Port Authority Airports. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are domestic flights, international flights. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey. The portal shows 2016-06-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
